title: Animals stories vs food and drink stories on points
question: Does a story about animals get more points than a story about food and drink?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about animals gets more points than a story about food and drink.
expect: If true, points per story for animals stories should be at least 1.5x the value for food and drink stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, animals against food and drink

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h340 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h340 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
